author: EmuCore - Hub
title: 5 PS2 Games on AetherSX2 Android [Part 1] | Mediatek Dimensity 700
summary: Adervish documents five AetherSX2 workloads on a Dimensity 700 Galaxy A22 5G, publishing resolution, backend, safety presets and observed slowdowns instead of hiding the compromises of a low-midrange phone.

blocks.text: The seven-minute benchmark is unusually candid. Digimon Rumble Arena 2 and SmackDown run at 1x, Metal Slug Anthology at 3x, Persona 4 at 2x and Gran Turismo 4 returns to 1x. OpenGL is chosen because Vulkan brought little improvement on this device; a fast/unsafe preset addresses Digimon slowdown while the remaining games use an optimal/safe baseline. Reported issues include delayed slowdown, loading-screen flicker, localized Persona drops and Gran Turismo 4 struggling even at native resolution.

The upload reflects a May 2022 “latest” AetherSX2 build that is no longer current, and it does not record the precise version, driver, temperatures, battery state or frame-time graphs. Fast/unsafe options can break timing or effects and should never become global defaults from one test. The creator explicitly refuses game links, which keeps the benchmark separate from distribution. Reproduce the same scene after thermal stabilization, compare OpenGL and Vulkan under identical settings, and prefer correctness before using speed hacks on another Dimensity 700 device.
